about: Batch 4a (the Cafeteria and the girls' corridor, redone in place) written early on 7 Oct 2026 at the owner's word, with: python3 tools/art_batch.py 4a --preview --record tools/art/staged/early/campus_for_batch2_third.json --out '~/Desktop/JJK Game images/ui2/early'. Judge its results with tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py <place> <a> <b> --dry, then by eye: the check has four known blind spots (art_3a_early.json).

chosen.said: the owner, in chat, 7 Oct 2026: "New cafetières look good. We need to redo the girls dorms as there are doors that lead to nothing."

cafeteria.version: a, unless the owner says b (both 'look good'; no letter was named)
cafeteria.install_redo_dry: version a PASS (nothing moved: 19 points, none off; nothing vanished or added; 12.0 times sharper). Version b LOOK (one window's view; 7.4 times sharper).
cafeteria.by_eye: Version a's windows show packed earth and a long white building under a grey roof, which is the School Courtyard the owner chose; version b's show only trees.

girls_dorm.note: TO BE REDONE at the owner's word: the corridor has eight doors and two rooms (Nobara's, the first door on the left; Maki's, the first door on the right), so six doors lead nowhere. Painted again as art_4r.json: the same corridor with only those two doors. (For the record, the check refused both versions of this sitting, for the same kinds of false alarm as in art_3a_early.json.)
